scope: Independent global-currency normalization, numerical precision, provenance, dates/freshness, official UF parsing, cache/failure/privacy and bounded browser integration QA.

resolvedFindings.behavior: Same-instrument conversion returns rate1 without fetching, preserving123.45USD.
Expired spot and daily quotes are pruned independently. Valid daily pairs survive refresh failure; USD identity remains available. Structural corruption is rejected before pruning.
Tomorrow observations and future retrieval timestamps rejected; impossible contributor dates and nonboolean exclusions rejected.
Inverse-quote attribution and peg status replace the coarse quote provenance; omitted expanded providers retain the documented Frankfurter peg interpretation.
API does not relabel USD mathematical identity as a blended peg quote.
SII current date/year follows America/Santiago, including after midnight UTC and UTC New Year; blank observations are never silently replaced.
UF zero and malformed localized decimals are rejected; exact dated values are parsed across multi-column day cells.
Positive quote/cross-rate underflow is rejected instead of returning a plausible zero.

independentEvidence.gold: Pinned direct XAU/USD4138.78 gives2XAU=8277.56USD; avoids coarse1/.00024 inversion.
independentEvidence.vnd: Pinned direct USD/VND25868 preserves25868VND=1USD; avoids coarse inverse .000039.
independentEvidence.sources: Primary cached evidence in /tmp/finflo-state-currency-research; no competitor output used as arithmetic oracle.

networkPrivacy.browser: Exactly one mocked generic GET /api/global-rates, no query/body/amount/selected currencies, no third-party request. Subsequent conversion and matrix operations use browser snapshot.
networkPrivacy.tests: All formal tests and39isolated checks mock upstream fetches. One separately recorded actual endpoint smoke was the only live upstream exercise.
networkPrivacy.spotPolicy: 15-minute retrieval-age cutoff; daily14-day source-age policy verified at relevant boundaries.

limits: The single live endpoint smoke occurred before USD-source metadata was corrected; the correction is verified by final isolated and formal mocked endpoint tests. It was not refetched merely to refresh evidence.
Browser automation used cached synthetic quotes with independent expected arithmetic; no claim that its numeric sample values are currently tradable rates.
Automated axe and Chromium emulation are bounded checks, not a full independent accessibility certification.
Snapshot and test counts overlap; do not sum them as distinct coverage.
